parties.counterparty: SFG Financial Corp, a/k/a E-Path FX (Licensor)

plans.note: Article VIX carries the warranty disclaimer in all caps; a liability cap/consequential damages exclusion is most likely bundled there or in the general provisions of Article XXIV. Check mutuality, cap size relative to fees, and carve-outs (confidentiality, IP infringement, willful misconduct).

No article heading signals indemnity; a vendor IP indemnity may sit near the warranty disclaimer (Article VIX) or in general provisions. If only a Licensee-side indemnity appears, treat as deviation; if none, flag missing vendor IP/misconduct indemnity.

Article II licence restrictions and the Article X confidentiality/non-solicitation block are the likely homes for any restraint on Licensee's business or on building/buying competing FX platforms; also check the FIELD OF USE definition in Article I for a disguised restraint.

The defined terms include 'Right of First Refusal', which typically operates as an exclusivity/first-call restraint on us; locate the operative ROFR text (likely Article VIII or the general provisions) and any sole-source language in Article II.

Pricing sits in the tiered per-trade table around Article VIII; no heading suggests an MFN. Only flag if a clause obliges us to extend best terms to Licensor — an MFN in our favour is welcome and not redlined.

Article X is expressly captioned 'CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION'. Check duration, mutuality, scope (employees vs. customers) and whether general advertising/unsolicited applicants are carved out.

Term/termination is likely in Article VIII or the Article XXIV general provisions; 'Initial Period' is defined in Article I. Confirm we may terminate on notice without penalty and that Licensor cannot exit mid-term at will.
Look for auto-renewal tied to the defined 'Initial Period' — check the notice window for non-renewal (should be no more than 30-60 days) and any uncapped renewal price uplift in the fee tiers.

Standard placement is the Article XXIV general provisions. Confirm New York (or DE/CA/E&W) law and a courts forum rather than offshore arbitration; New York is likely given the 575 Madison Avenue addresses.

Assignment/successors language should be in the Article XXIV general provisions; check we may assign to Affiliates and to a successor by merger without consent, and that our change of control is not a Licensor termination trigger.

Article I defines DERIVATIVE WORK, INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS, MORAL RIGHTS and LICENSED TECHNOLOGY; Article II sets the grant and restrictions. Watch for assignment to Licensor of our data, feedback, configurations or derivative works.
Article II is the grant and restrictions clause; test scope against Affiliates and contractors, the FIELD OF USE limitation, and any right for Licensor to revoke or suspend the licence at will.

Per-trade pricing usually brings a records/verification right; look in Article II restrictions and the Article VIII fee provisions. Test frequency, notice, business-hours limits, off-site review and who bears cost.
Check the fee/'Supplemental Payments' mechanics near Article VIII for shortfall charges, penalty interest or accelerated fees payable by us; service credits running to us are not to be flagged.

Article VIX is an all-caps WARRANTY DISCLAIMER expressly negating merchantability, non-infringement and fitness, and disclaiming that defects will be corrected — likely a deviation for lack of any affirmative performance warranty or repair/replace/refund remedy.
No insurance heading appears in the outline; sweep Article XXIV general provisions before recording as missing, given Licensor hosts the Platform and touches our trade data.

The tiered per-Market Day/volume price table plus the defined 'Supplemental Payments' suggests a volume floor or minimum monthly fee; confirm whether any commitment is take-or-pay and whether we can exit or true-down.

No wind-down heading is visible; check the effects-of-termination text in Article XXIV and the Article X confidentiality return-of-materials provision, which may only require us to return Licensor materials without giving us our data back or migration help.
